title: Blue winged 'angel' UAP over Barber's house
summary: Jake Barber tells of Blue winged 'angel' UAP over Barber's house, about an unknown time at Jake Barber's home, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

he said you know probably as a result of his work with crash retrievals and UFOs he has this sort of wing sphere thing show up at his house
tellings.difference: Michels tells it second hand and links its appearance to Barber's crash-retrieval work.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the winged object, called the angel, that shows up over Jake Barber's house.

as_told.title: Wing-sphere object appears at Jake Barber's house

tellings.difference: Adds that it is blue, materializes, is seen by the neighbours and shoots into space. The house is attributed to Blitch, not Barber.
tellings.link_reason: The quote is nearly word for word the same as Barber's telling of the blue winged angel UAP that shows up over the house.

as_told.title: The blue 'angel' UAP over Blitch's house

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once helped retrieve a UFO, told podcast host Jesse Michels that an unidentified object shows up over his house. He says his family calls it "the angel" because it looks blue and seems to have wings. He does not say when this happens.
